svg.aria-label: Merging concurrent text edits. Both users start with the word ice. User A inserts n at position 0, giving nice; user B inserts an exclamation mark at position 3, giving ice!. Applied naively, B's position 3 is now wrong on A's copy, producing nic!e. Operational transformation shifts B's position to 4 because A inserted before it. A CRDT instead gives every character a unique ID and inserts relative to IDs, so both replicas converge on nice!.
